title: I Am Sartana, Your Angel of Death
writer: Tito Carpi, Enzo Dell'Aquila, Ernesto Gastaldi
actors: Gianni Garko, Frank Wolff, Ettore Manni
plot: Having been framed for a bank holdup, Sartana must find the real culprits and clear his name, all while staying one step ahead of opportunistic bounty hunters aiming to do him in.
